title: Delphi workspace config.toml
description: Validate config.toml parsed to JSON. Shape and enumerations only: `delphi doctor` is authoritative and also checks credentials, ratification and cross-references. Sections the code reads but that this schema leaves open (session, relay, away, optimistic, learning, hooks) are declared as plain objects. [[endpoints]], [access], [auth.*], [connectors.*], [harness.*] and [exec] are ratified: a change is a Red-tier proposal. API keys never appear here. The annotated template is crates/delphi/config.example.toml.

projects.description: Project repos the workspace operates on; `~/` is expanded.

untrusted_paths.description: Globs whose tracked files read as external_untrusted.

isolated.description: True: nothing is ever promoted out of this workspace.

hide_bibliographies.description: When searching the knowledge base in the console, resolve to summary markdown pages instead of bibliography sidecars (specs/075). Default true.

models.description: `[models.<family>]` maps tier to model ID; `[models.catalog."<id>"]` holds per-model limits and prices.

interactive.description: Roles the operator can directly @ on session start.

forbidden.description: Quarantined roles; orchestrator dispatch and direct interaction are blocked.

fleet.description: Fleet accessibility mode for the orchestrator (default: all).

adopt_threshold.description: The confidence at or above which route marks its best candidate adopt = true (specs/098 section 8). Provisional default 0.55; delphi route --adopt-eval measures a labeled set.

registry.description: How the orchestrator learns of bundle agents (specs/041). flat: one line per agent, up to 20. auto: past 20, a domain index and the search_agent_registry tool.

assignment.description: How a dispatch picks its model (specs/056). static: the role's tier. discovered: capability class, measured results and quota.

evidence_enough.description: Measured results per (role, kind, model) after which a model is scored by them alone.

emergency_endpoint.description: A local endpoint (cost_model = local) whose model saves state when every ratified seat is out of quota (specs/056 section 3.5). Set together with emergency_model; off when unset.

emergency_model.description: The model on emergency_endpoint that writes the unverified emergency hand-off record.

reserve.description: Role to the share of the mission budget no other role may spend.

council_budget_tokens.description: Input plus output tokens one Council may use (default 400000); 0 turns it off (spec 123 section 4).

council_budget_usd.description: Kept for compatibility: still checked; council_budget_tokens is the ceiling to set.

council.description: Councils, Panels and the progress a status call reports (spec 098 section 19).

stall_secs.description: A status call flags a Council stalled when every seat still working has been idle this many seconds (default 120). 0 turns the flag off.

earlier_rulings.description: Show a Council's Round 2, repair turn and synthesis (a Panel's verdict brief) up to two earlier Council records whose proposition headline matches, as fenced untrusted context; never Round 1 (default true; spec 123 section 9).

hosts.description: Settings for the tools you code with (specs/098).

route_adopt.description: Removed (specs/098 section 13.2): ignored. route's adopt is always a recommendation. The key stays here so an old config still validates; delphi doctor names it.

source_ladder.description: Removed (specs/098 section 13.2): ignored. The source ladder is in the scout, investigator and red-team manifests and is always served, and `delphi mcp --print-claude-md` always includes the research reflex. The key stays here so an old config still validates; delphi doctor names it.

seats.description: Foreign seats and model families (spec 091 SR-3, SR-4).

require_families.description: Refuse a Panel that cannot show this many distinct known model families, before anything is spent. Unset (the default) never refuses; the result is labelled homogeneous.

max_foreign_seats.description: Foreign seats one Council may run (default 1). 0 turns them off.

red_team_kind.description: Removed (specs/098 section 13.2): ignored. council_open always accepts kind: red_team. The key stays here so an old config still validates; delphi doctor names it.

max_foreign_tokens.description: Tokens the foreign seats of one Council may use (default 100000).

nudge_edits.description: Writes to one file before the nudge; twice this ends the span.

tool_result_limit_kb.description: A tool result over this many KB is stored in the payload store and the history keeps a handle and a preview. 0 is off.

clear_after_kb.description: Old tool results are replaced by a handle in batches of about this many KB. 0 is off.

trim_arguments_kb.description: Old tool calls whose arguments reach this many KB keep a handle in place of their large text fields. 0 is off.

keep_recent_turns.description: Assistant turns, counted from the end, that clearing and trimming leave whole.

hard.description: Shell lines that are always Hard: a Red card.

search.description: Web search engines for the archives pane's research mode (specs/028 section 10), tried in order, one at a time. Unset means the keyless parallel engine (specs/028 section 12); an empty list means research cannot run.

research.description: How a research answer describes its coverage (specs/098 section 7.5).

young_domain_days.description: A registrable domain younger than this counts zero toward corroboration, when its age is known (specs/098 section 7.6). Default 180.

burst_hours.description: Citations first seen within this many hours of each other count once, when their first-seen times are known. Default 24.

similar_above.description: Pages more similar than this are one origin. Never looser than the validator's own 0.5 (specs/040 section 6.2). Default 0.8.

unfamiliar_counts.description: Whether a domain no list names counts as an origin. A domain a list calls weak, and every excluded one, count zero either way. Default true.

thin_below.description: Fewer kept, cited claims than this from the knowledge base and the trusted sources together make a research answer say coverage: thin, and name the host rungs (close sources, the wider web) that can take over. Default 3.

refresh_days.description: Due research topics (specs/112 section 5): a topic whose newest run is older than this many days is listed as due. Nothing is run again by itself. Default 90.

refresh_days_min.description: The least a research record's own refresh_days counts as. Default 7.

refresh_days_max.description: The most a research record's own refresh_days counts as. Default 730.

continue_overlap.description: Known first (specs/114 section 3): a new research question continues a topic Delphi has when that topic's question holds at least this share of the new question's content words and its best search result reaches continue_score. Default 0.5.

continue_score.description: The retrieval score a topic's best result must reach for a new question to continue it (the index's fused rank score: about 0.003 for a result that holds every word of a question and ranks first by keywords, 0.02 to 0.05 for one near the question by meaning when an embedding model is installed). Default 0.003.

archive_fallback.description: Archived copies (specs/101 section 5). On: when a re-check finds a PUBLIC source the daemon fetched itself gone, and no readable text is held, the daemon asks one web archive whether it holds a copy and keeps it as a labelled version of the source. Read-only (nothing is ever saved to the archive); a private source or an address that is not public sends nothing; a copy adds no origin and no trusted source. The explicit command `delphi sources archive` works either way. Default true (specs/119 section 14).

archive_endpoint.description: The one archive endpoint asked about a public URL (specs/101 section 7): the Internet Archive's Availability API by default. Must be https. Default https://archive.org/wayback/available.

citation_chaining.description: Citation chaining (specs/101 section 6). On: a research run asks one pinned citation index what each of the run's best public works cites and what cites it, and keeps the DOIs it names as noted leads (recorded, never fetched). Only a public DOI of a source the daemon fetched itself is sent; a private source, an unreadable record, a source with no DOI, and any claim resting on a private source send nothing. A chained find adds no origin and changes no status. Default true (specs/119 section 14).

citation_endpoint.description: The one citation index asked about a public DOI (specs/101 section 7): OpenCitations' Index API v2 by default. Must be https, with no credentials, query or fragment. Default https://api.opencitations.net/index/v2.

chain_depth.description: With citation chaining on: levels followed from the seed works. A hypothesis to calibrate from the search log. Default 1.

chain_fanout.description: With citation chaining on: seed works a level. A hypothesis. Default 2.

chain_max_per_seed.description: With citation chaining on: works kept per seed; the rest are counted as not followed. A hypothesis. Default 10.

chain_max_calls.description: With citation chaining on: calls to the index per run, inside the run's step budget. A hypothesis. Default 30.

doi_endpoint.description: With citation chaining on: the DOI-resolution endpoint a chained work is resolved at before its landing address is captured once (specs/101 section 6 item 8). https only, no credentials, query or fragment. Default https://doi.org/api/handles.

chain_max_pages.description: With citation chaining on: chained works read as pages per run (one resolution request and one capture each; the requests count against chain_max_calls). A hypothesis. Default 5.

ladder.description: Removed (specs/098 section 13.2): ignored. The wider fetch (section 7.5 item 7a) is always on, inside the two caps below. The key stays here so an old config still validates; delphi doctor names it.

fetch_per_host.description: With the wider fetch on: distinct off-list pages read from one host in one run. A hypothesis to calibrate from the status. Default 2.

fetch_per_run.description: With the wider fetch on: distinct off-list pages read in one run. A hypothesis to calibrate from the status. Default 10.

search_log.description: Removed (specs/098 section 13.2): ignored. Every host research result carries its search log (specs/101 section 3). The key stays here so an old config still validates; delphi doctor names it.

images.description: Research runs and record_research keep the pictures of the pages whose text they keep, under the picture licence decision, each with its licence record; a refused picture is listed in the run's record with the reason (specs/118 section 3). Default true; false fetches no picture.

svg.description: SVG pictures are drawn to PNG at capture (the SVG kept beside it, never served) only when true; false, the default, refuses an SVG picture before it is parsed, recorded as svg_off (specs/118 section 11). Other formats are not affected.

retractions.description: Check a source's DOI against the local Retraction Watch snapshot at capture, at re-check and on import (specs/101 section 4). A retracted work, or one under an expression of concern, stops counting as an origin; a claim only a retracted source supports becomes contested; a correction is a label. Nothing is deleted and nothing is sent to a service. Default true (specs/119 section 14).

retractions_stale_days.description: A snapshot imported more than this many days ago is called stale in the coverage report and by delphi doctor. Default 90.

limits.description: The limits of a research run, one table for every caller: the console's /research, an inside agent's request_research and a host's (specs/112 section 4 item 6). The defaults are the host runner's figures of before the table. A value outside its range keeps the default.

pages_quick.description: Pages read by a quick run. Default 3.

pages_survey.description: Pages read by a survey run. Default 6.

pages_deep.description: Pages read by a deep run. Default 10.

steps_quick.description: The step budget (searches and fetches) of a quick run; the check has a quarter of it on top, at least two. A run that reaches it returns partial. Default 5.

steps_survey.description: The step budget of a survey run. Default 15.

steps_deep.description: The step budget of a deep run. Default 30.

job_secs.description: A running job is stopped after this many seconds and reports failed. Default 600.

concurrent.description: Research jobs that run at once, whoever asked; the rest wait in order. Default 2.

page_chars.description: How much of one page the scout reads, in characters. Default 24000.

depth.description: The depth of a run started from the console or by an inside agent, which name none. Default survey.

pictures_per_source.description: Pictures kept with one source whose text is kept, in a run from the console or an inside agent (a host's run keeps none). 0 keeps none. Default 6.

pictures_per_run.description: Pictures fetched in one such run. Default 24.

tiers.description: The confidence ladder (specs/100 section 3.2): when a claim reads corroborated, substantiated or vetted. Derived by code from tags; each rung reads not validated (vetted reads vetted) and is weaker than validated; none grants anything. Numbers are defaults to calibrate.

substantiated_trusted.description: Trusted sources, among those origins, for substantiated. Default 1.

vetted_origins.description: Independent origins for vetted (never fewer than corroborated_origins). Default 5.

vetted_trusted.description: Trusted sources for vetted (never fewer than substantiated_trusted); vetted also needs the validator's would_ratify. Default 2.

corroborated_enabled.description: Whether the corroborated rung is shown. Off: the claim reads noted. Default true.

substantiated_enabled.description: Whether the substantiated rung is shown. Off: it falls back one rung. Default true.

vetted_enabled.description: Whether the vetted rung is shown. Off: it falls back one rung. Default true.

fast_lane_enabled.description: Whether the validator is offered a higher rung's claims first (queue order only; a claim's status never changes). Default true.

acquire.description: Library acquisition (specs/055 section 8): a daily job proposes public-domain and research sources in ONE digest batch. Off until enabled; it reaches out to the archives listed in context/sources/archives.toml.

byte_budget_mib.description: Bytes acquisition may hold; reaching it stops acquiring and evicts nothing.

max_item_mib.description: The largest text one acquired source may have.

token_share_percent.description: The scout's share of the install's tokens over the trailing week (specs/040 section 20.2). 0 keeps the job model-free.

interests.description: Topics you want, beside the workspace's project names.

unknown_licence.description: How much of a web page whose licence is unknown or closed a research run keeps (specs/119 section 3): excerpts keeps each quoted passage (at most 300 characters, with up to 200 on either side) as a searched, anchored excerpt; pointer keeps no text; private_text keeps the whole text as a private source that never leaves the install and is quoted at most 300 characters at a time.

private_text_max_mib.description: The most text private_text keeps, in MiB; past it the oldest is removed first (the pointer and claims stay).

private_to_models.description: Whether a private entry may be placed in the prompt of a model of the host's own family (specs/098 section 7.2). A private entry is never placed in a foreign-family seat's prompt, whatever this says. `delphi doctor` warns when it is `allow` and private entries exist.

pages.description: Generated search pages (specs/057 sections 5 and 6). A page is always labelled generated and not authoritative.

enabled.description: false: no page is written; searches still list the library's results.

external.description: ask: external search only when the operator asks (--external, or the console's key). off: never. on: every page also searches the web, unless --internal. Private sources never leave the install.

max_tokens.description: The longest page the writer may write, in tokens.

external_ttl.description: How long a page that used external search stays fresh: a number of days, or a duration such as 12h or 7d.

per_day.description: Pages the daemon builds in one day (a cache hit is free). Their validator tokens also count against the validator's share (specs/040 section 20).

min_ttl_days.description: The shortest cache lifetime, in days, the daemon accepts for a page the writer proposed one for (specs/097).

max_ttl_days.description: The longest cache lifetime, in days, the daemon accepts for a page the writer proposed one for (specs/097).

auto_rebuild.description: Topic pages that are due (a claim or source they cite changed, a new claim carries their topic, or their lifetime passed) are rebuilt by the daemon while it is idle, within per_day (specs/117 section 2 item 3). false: only `delphi pages rebuild` rebuilds them.

validator.description: The fact validator (specs/040 section 15.1). The effective mode is the lower of this value and the daemon's latch.

mode.description: off: no fetch of any kind. advisory: the full fact path as a dry run that writes nothing validated. ratify: real writes, only after PROMOTE.

weak_sources.description: A claim supported only by Weak sources: label keeps it as unverified (weak), never as evidence; off refuses it (specs/040 section 27).

background.description: While the daemon is idle, check queued library claims in advisory mode (never ratifies), inside a daily token cap and 10 percent of the install's week (specs/040 section 18.3, 20.2).

sources.description: The operator's additions to the default source list (specs/040 appendix A). Registrable domains.

order.description: Family to endpoint IDs, in preference order.

standing_foreign_tokens.description: The operator's standing consent for read-only foreign seats: tokens per 24 hours they may spend without operator_confirmed on each call (specs/104 §5). 0, the default, is off. Pinned: only the ratified copy counts.

harness.description: `[harness.claude]`, `[harness.agy]`, `[harness.codex]` and `[harness.copilot]` narrow the subscription-CLI defaults; scalar keys on `[harness]` itself (for example connector_settle_secs, subscription_budget_tokens) apply to all.

grades.description: Promote and nerf (specs/056 §4): a role's grade from -2 to 2, or a table of grades per task kind with `default` for the role itself. Ratified: an edit is a pending proposal until /ratify.

learning.description: The learning loop (specs/031 section 3.6). Each number is clamped to the core's floor and ceiling at boot. No key loads unratified content; an unknown key is a boot notice.

capture.description: Stage notes from denials, corrections, retries and escalations. Default true. Turning it off is allowed.

max_notes.description: Staged notes kept per mission; the oldest is dropped. Default 200.

triggers.description: Which capture triggers are on. Default all.

retro_min_tasks.description: Finished tasks before `delphi needs` says the coaching pass has material. Default 10.

exposure_randomization.description: Withhold a newly ratified rule from about half of its first 20 tasks to measure it; security and always rules and holdout tasks never. Default false.

history.description: The project history (specs/102 section 7): the operator's own redacted prompts with capped summaries, on this machine only. On by default (opt-out), but nothing is recorded until a person has answered the install question once in a terminal. Every record is private: it never leaves the install, and its text enters a model prompt only under to_models.

enabled.description: Keep a history of prompts and what came of them. Default true; nothing is recorded until the install question has been answered, and false records nothing.

paste_chars.description: A span longer than this is treated as pasted and stored as a keyed hash and a length, not text, unless the daemon saw it typed (a hypothesis to calibrate). Default 400.

to_models.description: Whether record text may enter a model prompt. Default deny. With allow, only a seat of the host's own family; never a foreign-family or unknown-family seat.

budget_mb.description: The store's cap per project, in megabytes; at the cap the daemon stops adding and says so (a hypothesis). Default 50.

retention_days.description: The age budget in days (a hypothesis). Default 90. Nothing is deleted at this age: delphi history status and doctor count the records past it.

timeline.description: The daemon timeline and report (ids and counts only, no operator text). Default true; it stays when records are off, and false turns it off too.

mcp.description: Delphi for host agents (specs/062 section 3.4): `delphi mcp`, an MCP server on stdio for the other tools you code with. Same machine and same user only.

enabled.description: false: every tool call is answered `disabled_by_operator`. Read at each call, so it takes effect at once. A config.toml that cannot be read as written also turns it off.

allow_remote.description: Reserved for a later spec. true is refused in this version.

badge_style.description: Which form of a Delphi agent's identity the `display` and `signature` fields carry (specs/066 section 7, specs/087 section 5). Plain is the default; the ansi and markdown forms are always sent beside it.

badge_mode.description: The terminal background the ANSI form of an identity is coloured for (specs/087 section 5.1). Delphi cannot see the host's terminal, so the operator says it once. The plain and markdown forms carry no colour and ignore it.

badge_ascii.description: Whether the badge in an identity is plain ASCII (for example [0-0] for the badge with the bullet-dash-bullet face), for a host whose terminal or font cannot draw the badge characters (specs/087 section 6.2). DELPHI_ASCII_BADGES=1 in the environment of the process that builds the identity has the same effect.

max_packs_per_task.description: How many different generated packs (spawn_agent_pack) one named task may have (specs/098 section 9). A cap on one-off agent definitions, not on calls: asking again for a pack already made costs nothing. 0 allows none.

max_packs_per_session.description: How many different generated packs one server session may have in all, so a host that cycles task names cannot spawn packs without end (specs/098 section 9). 0 allows none.

session_hooks.description: Whether `delphi mcp --hook <event>` prints into a host's context: a brief at session start, mention routing at the prompt (specs/105 section 2). On by default (specs/105 section 13); false, set by `delphi mcp --hooks off`, turns them off, and `delphi mcp --hooks on` at a terminal turns them back on. enabled = false silences the hooks whatever this says.

host.description: Subagent files for the other tools (specs/086 section 6.3).

models.description: Host, then council role, to the model name that host's generated subagent file asks for. Only hosts that take free names; no entry means the file sets no model.

auto.description: A span (a root span, and a child span on its first turn) starts with passages from the knowledge base, labelled and tainted. false: agents search only when they call kb_search.

start_passages.description: How many passages a span starts with (specs/116 section 4.2); at most two from one document. 0 gives none.

start_chars.description: How many characters the start passages may take in all (specs/116 section 4.2).

use_boost.description: Share of its score added to an item the daemon handed to spans that then ended well (specs/116 section 7 item 3): one count a task, saturating at three; a provisional note and an agent's own search earn none. 0 is off.

dispute_penalty.description: Share of its score taken from an item disputed with flag_wrong (counted disputes only) or by the operator; it is still returned, labelled. 0 is off.

confidence_weight.description: Share of its score added to a validated fact by the confidence the fact store recorded (high: all of it, medium: half); a file elsewhere that claims a confidence counts as low. 0 is off.

projects.description: Research recall across the workspace's projects (specs/115 section 2). The operator's setting: no agent can write it.

research_sharing.description: workspace: a session may read the research of the workspace's other projects that are not private, labelled with the project and as not checked; nothing else of another project is readable. project: a project's research is read by that project only. Read at each search, so a change needs no restart.

own_project_boost.description: Added to the score of a result of the session's own project, so it ranks ahead of another project's research at equal score (specs/115 section 3).

handling.description: Which arrival paths carry which handling traits (specs/121 section 3 item 1): personal (shown as private), internal, confidential. Not a trust tier. The operator's setting: no agent can write it. A table that fails its check configures nothing.

org_domains.description: The organisation's mail domains (example.com). A message or meeting whose every address is on one is also internal.

list_addresses.description: List addresses: an email sent to one is internal and not private.

company_wide_recipients.description: An email to more than this many recipients is company-wide: internal, not private.

path.description: [[handling.path]] rows. A matching row makes the path configured: a marking in the content counts only there, and so does the research weight of internal (specs/121 section 7). The longest matching `under` wins.

kind.description: A connector or import kind: email, dm, slack, wiki, private-doc, meeting, file, web, import, ...

under.description: The start of the item's locator (compared without case). Absent: every item of the kind.

traits.description: The traits the path carries; confidential brings internal. Empty: configured, carries none.

memory.description: Memory that grows (specs/116 sections 2 and 3): the provisional tier and the digest's daily limit. Neither key loads anything into a system prompt.

provisional.description: An agent's note is kept in the provisional tier (local/memory/provisional/<role>/), where a later span of the same role may be given it as a passage of data labelled unreviewed; a note written after reading untrusted content, or by a host, is never given automatically. false: notes stage as before and no provisional note is kept, indexed or retrieved. Read at each use, so it takes effect at once; a config.toml that cannot be read as written also turns it off.

digest_daily.description: How many items the digest shows a day (specs/116 section 3 item 4). 0 shows none.

consolidate.description: Consolidation (specs/116 section 6), once a day after five idle minutes. false: none. "mechanical": duplicate provisional notes of one role, kind and tier are merged, with no model. true or "model": that, and one tool-less model call per role proposes merges, contradictions, notes covered by a lesson and superseded findings; proposals go to the digest and change nothing until accepted, and none writes a lesson or a rule.

consolidate_tokens.description: The model pass's share of a day, in tokens (specs/116 section 6 item 1).

hooks.description: `[[hooks.observe]]` and `[[hooks.deny]]` (specs/018): commands that can only watch or refuse.

credential.description: Where the key comes from, as for an endpoint.

cx.description: Google only: the Programmable Search engine id.

credential.description: A credential reference (for example `aws:work-sso`), or `none` for a loopback base_url. Never a secret.

client_secret.description: A reference such as `keychain:google-client-secret`, never the secret.

harnessProfile.description: Unknown keys are refused by the program.
